title: IP Wizard
description: IP Wizard is an Android app for networking students and hobbyists who need to calculate IP addresses, subnet masks, network ranges, and broadcast addresses quickly and accurately. Enter an IP address and a CIDR prefix, and the app instantly computes all related values — no internet connection required. It was built specifically to match the format expected in Advanced Level ICT exam answers.
long-description: During Advanced Level ICT, subnet calculations were a regular part of the coursework. Existing online tools were either cluttered, inaccurate, or didn't match the exact format needed for exam answers. IP Wizard was built as a clean, offline-capable Android app that does exactly what's needed — nothing more, nothing less.

why-i-made-this.simple: For my A/L ICT exam in Sri Lanka, subnetting was a core topic. I built this to check my calculations offline.
why-i-made-this.extended: In Sri Lanka's Advanced Level ICT subject, subnetting is a required exam topic. Online tools were cluttered and none matched the exact output format needed for A/L answers. I built IP Wizard as a clean, offline Android app that does exactly what an A/L student needs — no ads, no noise.
